notices.title: Scheduled maintenance
notices.body: emtypyie.in, cluster0, cluster1, and auth.emtypyie.in will be under maintenance from 15th until 19th September 2026. Frontends will redirect to /503 for the duration.

notices.title: Backend clusters under maintenance
notices.body: cluster0 and cluster1 are offline for scheduled maintenance. Frontends redirect to /503 until the work completes. No action needed from your side.

notices.title: wiki and kepler verified operational
notices.body: Scheduled verification of the wiki and kepler deployments completed without incidents. Both remain reachable at their usual addresses.

notices.title: Status page goes live
notices.body: This page now runs live browser checks every 30 seconds and keeps a server-side record from GitHub Actions every 4 minutes. Notices will be posted here as things change.

notices.title: dosa.emtypyie.in permanently redirects to emtypyie.in/dosa
notices.body: The dosa.emtypyie.in subdomain now permanently redirects to emtypyie.in/dosa. Update any bookmarks or links pointing to the old address.
